Gazprom's own Dec 2021 completion release frames it explicitly as 'the expansion... at the section between Komsomolsk-on-Amur and Khabarovsk,' length 390.8 km, matching an Oct 2018 tender award for a 369 km duplicating string and Minenergo's independently-hosted project card. Classification (Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission) is corroborated by the pipeline's own listing as item 106, 'Магистральный газопровод Сахалин - Хабаровск - Владивосток' (trunk/transmission gas pipeline), in Russia's federal territorial planning scheme (sudact.ru).
